name: chips-with-autocomplete
description: A tag input combining mat-chip-grid for the selected tags with a MatAutocomplete panel for suggestions, supporting both free-text entry and picking a suggestion.
templateCode:
<mat-form-field appearance="outline">
  <mat-label>Tags</mat-label>
  <mat-chip-grid #chipGrid aria-label="Tag selection">
    <mat-chip *ngFor="let tag of tags" (removed)="remove(tag)">
      {{ tag }}
      <button matChipRemove><mat-icon>cancel</mat-icon></button>
    </mat-chip>
  </mat-chip-grid>
  <input
    placeholder="Add a tag..."
    [matChipInputFor]="chipGrid"
    [matAutocomplete]="auto"
    (matChipInputTokenEnd)="addFromInput($event)"
  />
  <mat-autocomplete #auto="matAutocomplete" (optionSelected)="addFromOption($event)">
    <mat-option *ngFor="let suggestion of filteredSuggestions" [value]="suggestion">
      {{ suggestion }}
    </mat-option>
  </mat-autocomplete>
</mat-form-field>
notes: matChipInputFor and matAutocomplete are both bound to the same input element but are independent integrations — matChipInputTokenEnd fires on separator keys (Enter/comma by default) for free-text entry, while (optionSelected) fires when a suggestion is picked from the panel; a complete implementation needs to handle both.
Always call event.chipInput?.clear() after committing a chip from matChipInputTokenEnd, or the raw text stays in the input alongside the newly added chip.
The suggestion list here is a plain array filtered by hand — pair the input's own (input) event with a filter over ALL_SUGGESTIONS if you want live filtering rather than a static list.
